category_title: At-risk dyscalculic pupils with core deficits in representing and processing numerosity
minimal_context: David is sitting in a one-on-one remedial setting and is asked to identify the number of pips on a domino card.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Good morning. Here are some domino cards. Let's look at the dots on this one.

STUDENT: Morning... (He nods his head, looking shy and nervous, and looks at the ground.)

TUTOR: Please tell me how many dots are on the card.

STUDENT: Eight. (He stared at the mathematics domino cards.)

TUTOR: How do you know?

STUDENT: I saw it.

options.A: Maintain an intensive schedule of one-on-one remedial intervention without providing any breaks during the mathematics lesson.
options.B: Use a visual schedule that identifies the lesson's activities and the reinforcers he is eligible to receive for contingent performance.
options.C: Use mathematics domino cards to illustrate quantities and adapt teaching to fit his current level of understanding.
options.D: Provide him with access to similar, but more socially appropriate, sensory stimulation using a squishy stress-relief ball.
